## Summary

- apply VFX Play/Stop/Restart as edge-triggered Timeline actions through ADR 0125 VfxPlayer controls
- reconstruct VFX state on Timeline seek through the existing deterministic preview-seek interface
- keep interval ownership and exact clip-end stop semantics in the engine composition adapter
- cover Play, Stop, Restart, and seek behavior with focused runtime tests
- keep the neutral Timeline crate independent of ADR 0125 runtime types
- apply the exact Rust 1.97.1 rustfmt output reported by affected Windows Validation
- correct internal VFX child-module visibility so Timeline composition can use the adapter without widening the public API

This current-main rebuild supersedes #949 after overlapping main drift required the INC-004 recovery path.

## Validation

Windows Validation uses impact-based affected planning. Visual Validation is not required because this change adds runtime adapter behavior and tests without changing Editor or Launcher presentation.
